subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Number 1: recognises, names and writes the numeral 1 and number word 'one'

show.line: This is one. One nose. Touch your nose. One!

rounds.prompt: How many noses do you have? Tap the number.
Draw one with your finger. Start at the top and go down.

hints: Look for the line that stands up straight.
One is just one thing. Like one nose.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the noses.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! There is only one nose.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count it together. One nose!

parent_line: Can recognise, say and trace the number 1.
